description: Atomically replace the caller-owned portfolio risk mandate, including optional per-underlying Derive Greek limits. Exact live Derive quotes enforce configured limits while allowing risk-reducing orders. This cannot widen API-key, owner-signed, venue, or agent limits. Requires the current version and a stable idempotency key.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

allocation_targets.description: Complete allocation target set. Values must add to exactly 100 percent.

derive_greek_limits.description: Optional per-underlying Derive gamma, theta, and vega limits. Omit to preserve; send [] to clear. Each row needs at least one limit.

asset.description: Canonical Derive underlying such as BTC or ETH.

max_abs_net_gamma.description: max abs net gamma in Derive venue-native position-Greek units.

max_abs_net_theta.description: max abs net theta in Derive venue-native position-Greek units.

max_abs_net_vega.description: max abs net vega in Derive venue-native position-Greek units.

max_gross_gamma.description: max gross gamma in Derive venue-native position-Greek units.

max_gross_theta.description: max gross theta in Derive venue-native position-Greek units.

max_gross_vega.description: max gross vega in Derive venue-native position-Greek units.

limits.description: Complete portfolio-risk limit set. Omitted or unknown limits are rejected.

hedge_at_net_exposure_pct.description: Linear net exposure above which a hedge is proposed.

max_asset_concentration_pct.description: Maximum absolute linear net exposure to one asset.

max_gross_exposure_pct.description: Maximum combined live notional as account-value percent.

max_position_pct.description: Maximum single-position notional as account-value percent.

min_cash_reserve_pct.description: Minimum verified free cash kept outside live positions.

rebalance_drift_pct.description: Allocation drift required before a move is proposed.

risk_per_trade_pct.description: Maximum account value risked at invalidation on one trade.

target_portfolio_vol_pct.description: Annualized volatility target used by volatility sizing.

mode.description: Presentation mode. Both modes use the same server enforcement.

profile.description: Guided preset or custom advanced policy.

name: update_portfolio_mandate
